---
title: "HTML format"
subtitle: "One accessible page per document, in light and dark."
description: "What mcanouil-html gives a page: the title block, the contents and sidebar per preset, the page footer, the components, and the accessibility targets."
---

```yaml
format: mcanouil-html
```

`mcanouil-html` renders the `report`, `article`, `memo` and `workshop` types as one page.
A Quarto book also renders with it.
The target is WCAG 2.2 AA in every preset, in light and dark.
The site renders [this page](../demos/gold.html) with the format.
The [demos](../demos.qmd) show the page in each preset.

## Title block

The title block is the banner of the page.
It holds the kicker, the title, a rule in the style of the preset, the subtitle, the authors, the abstract and the corner motif.
In a memo, it is the memo banner with the banner fields.

## Contents

The contents is off by default.
Set `toc: true` to show it:

```yaml
format:
  mcanouil-html:
    toc: true
```

When it is on, the contents is a `nav` landmark with a label.
Each preset has its own look for the contents and the sidebar of a book: the current entry, hover, focus, long titles that wrap, and print.
The current entry does not rely on colour alone.

Below 768 px, the embedded mobile-toc tool replaces the contents with a button.
The button opens the contents in a sheet at the bottom of the screen.

## Page footer

The page footer shows the three footer slots of the document type.
See [Header and footer](../reference.qmd#header-and-footer).

## Components

Callouts, tabsets, code blocks, tables, block quotes and the other structured elements have the style of the preset, the same in HTML, Reveal.js and Typst:

- `gold`: tinted callouts with a gilded edge, tabs with a gilded underline.
- `mono`: no fills, a thick top rule in the callout colour, a segmented tab bar.
- `quarto`: a frame in the callout colour with the label in its top edge, code in a line frame, pill tabs.
- `terminal`: the same frame with dashes and a thick start edge, code in a square line frame, `[ R ]` tabs.

A callout always has a text label.
Its icon is decorative.

## Accessibility

- Landmarks for the banner, the contents, the main content and the footer.
- A skip link as the first focusable element.
- Focus rings at 3:1 or more, in the link colour of the preset.
- No decoration under text, and no decoration in the accessibility tree.
- Forced colours mode removes the decoration and keeps a visible marker on the current entry.
- Animations play only when the reader has no reduced motion setting.
- A figure without alt text gives a warning at render time.
